messages:
mia_cs: Quick ask 40min: Can we create a one-page run-card for Polaris (acct-9912) focusing on prefill, caching, batching, streaming fallback, and renewal signal capture? Need customer-ready copy and tiny SDK snippets.

dan_eng: Draft run-card bullets below, keeping ops toggles minimal.

dan_eng: RUN-CARD (customer-facing):
- Prefill: call /v1/prefill with top 3 prompts 10m before peak. curl included.
- Cache: set prefix_cache=true and prefix_cache_ttl=600s for templates.
- Batching: recommended start config: max_batch_size=5, max_tokens=256, max_batch_delay=20ms.
- If token rate spikes: lower max_tokens to 128 and enable burst_throttle_ms=10.
- Streaming fallback: set streaming=true if >5% truncation rate.
- Renewal capture: client emits renewal_signal events for high-quality answers.

noah_sre: On-call quick checks: p50/p95 latency dashboards, 5xx% over 1m, KV cache hit rate. If 5xx >1% for 2m -> fallback model and notify #incidents.

ella_pm: Tiny SDK snippet for emitEvent to include in note (JS):
```js
analytics.emit('renewal_signal',{tenantId:'9912',promptId:'summary_v1',score:0.95})
```

dan_eng: Also add a non-deploy route override JSON so their ops can tweak batching without CI.

dan_eng: I'll push a short doc and the curl + JS snippets to /docs/customers/9912/run_card.

mia_cs: Thanks team 20min follow-up: I'll DM the CSM and post this run-card to the customer thread. Closing once CSM ack. :white_check_mark:
